name: structured-certificate-validation-domain-v1.4
description: Curated deterministic structured certificate validation prompts for rating, bonding, SPD typing, and measurement-derived review workflows. Threshold-driven checks rely on pipeline-derived categorical flags so the rule engine remains operator-compatible.

rules.message: The recorded main switch rating does not match the recorded incomer rating, so the supply arrangement or data entry should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Main switch rating conflicts with the recorded incomer rating.

reportTargets.reason: Main switch rating should be reviewed alongside the incomer rating.
Incomer rating should be reviewed alongside the main switch rating.

observation.title: Main switch and incomer ratings should be checked together
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records different ratings for the main switch and incomer.

rules.message: An SPD type is recorded but the certificate does not indicate SPD presence, so surge protection details should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Recorded SPD type conflicts with SPD presence being marked absent.

reportTargets.reason: SPD presence should normally align with a recorded SPD type.
SPD type should be checked against the recorded presence.

observation.title: SPD presence and SPD type should be aligned
observation.comment: Structured certificate data records an SPD type while SPD presence is marked absent.

rules.message: The certificate indicates SPD is present but no recognised SPD type is recorded, so the surge protection entry should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: SPD is marked present without a recognised SPD type entry.

reportTargets.reason: SPD presence should be reviewed with the SPD type entry.
SPD type should be recorded when SPD is marked present.

observation.title: SPD type should be recorded when SPD is present
observation.comment: Structured certificate data indicates SPD presence without a recognised SPD type value.

rules.message: Structured certificate data indicates gas bonding is not present, so main protective bonding to gas should be reviewed in context.
rules.summaryComment: Gas bonding is marked absent in the structured certificate data.

reportTargets.reason: Gas bonding entry should be reviewed against site conditions and certificate notes.
If bonding exists, the conductor size should also be confirmed.

observation.title: Gas bonding provision should be reviewed
observation.comment: Structured certificate data marks gas bonding as not present.

rules.message: Structured certificate data indicates water bonding is not present, so main protective bonding to water should be reviewed in context.
rules.summaryComment: Water bonding is marked absent in the structured certificate data.

reportTargets.reason: Water bonding entry should be reviewed against site conditions and certificate notes.
If bonding exists, the conductor size should also be confirmed.

observation.title: Water bonding provision should be reviewed
observation.comment: Structured certificate data marks water bonding as not present.

rules.message: The measured Ze value has been categorised by the pipeline as impossible or suspicious, so the external earth fault loop impedance result should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: Measured Ze has been flagged as impossible or suspicious by structured validation.

reportTargets.reason: Ze should be reviewed against the earthing arrangement and original test record.

observation.title: Ze measurement should be verified
observation.comment: A pipeline-derived validation flag marks the structured Ze value as impossible or suspicious.

rules.message: The measured Zs value has been categorised by the pipeline as impossible or suspicious, so the circuit earth fault loop impedance result should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: Measured Zs has been flagged as impossible or suspicious by structured validation.

reportTargets.reason: Zs should be reviewed against the circuit protective device and original test record.

observation.title: Zs measurement should be verified
observation.comment: A pipeline-derived validation flag marks the structured Zs value as impossible or suspicious.

rules.message: The measured PFC value has been categorised by the pipeline as impossible or suspicious, so the prospective fault current result should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: Measured PFC has been flagged as impossible or suspicious by structured validation.

reportTargets.reason: PFC should be reviewed against the original test reading and device ratings.

observation.title: PFC measurement should be verified
observation.comment: A pipeline-derived validation flag marks the structured PFC value as impossible or suspicious.

rules.message: The measured PSCC value has been categorised by the pipeline as impossible or suspicious, so the prospective short-circuit current result should be checked.
rules.summaryComment: Measured PSCC has been flagged as impossible or suspicious by structured validation.

reportTargets.reason: PSCC should be reviewed against the original test reading and device ratings.

observation.title: PSCC measurement should be verified
observation.comment: A pipeline-derived validation flag marks the structured PSCC value as impossible or suspicious.

rules.message: The measured Ze value has been categorised as outside a safe heuristic threshold for the recorded context, so the reading should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Measured Ze exceeds a pipeline-derived safe heuristic threshold.

reportTargets.reason: Ze should be checked where the pipeline has flagged it above a safe heuristic threshold.

observation.title: Ze safe-threshold heuristic exceeded
observation.comment: A pipeline-derived threshold flag indicates the structured Ze value should be reviewed.

rules.message: The measured Zs value has been categorised as outside a safe heuristic threshold for the recorded context, so the reading should be reviewed.
rules.summaryComment: Measured Zs exceeds a pipeline-derived safe heuristic threshold.

reportTargets.reason: Zs should be checked where the pipeline has flagged it above a safe heuristic threshold.

observation.title: Zs safe-threshold heuristic exceeded

rules.summaryComment: Measured PFC falls outside a pipeline-derived safe heuristic threshold.

reportTargets.reason: PFC should be checked where the pipeline has flagged it outside a safe heuristic range.

observation.title: PFC safe-threshold heuristic exceeded
